  "content": "import { View } from \"react-native\";\n\nimport type { ScoreBand } from \"@/features/crs/rules\";\n\nimport { Text } from \"./ui/text\";\n\nconst BAND_STYLES: Record<\n  ScoreBand,\n  { container: string; dot: string; text: string; bar: string }\n> = {\n  strong: {\n    container: \"bg-success-surface\",\n    dot: \"bg-success\",\n    text: \"text-success\",\n    bar: \"bg-success\",\n  },\n  average: {\n    container: \"bg-warning-surface\",\n    dot: \"bg-warning\",\n    text: \"text-warning\",\n    bar: \"bg-warning\",\n  },\n  low: {\n    container: \"bg-danger-surface\",\n    dot: \"bg-accent\",\n    text: \"text-accent\",\n    bar: \"bg-accent\",\n  },\n};\n\nexport const BAND_LABELS: Record<ScoreBand, string> = {\n  strong: \"At or above the latest CEC cutoff\",\n  average: \"Within 49 points of the latest CEC cutoff\",\n  low: \"More than 49 points below the latest CEC cutoff\",\n};\n\nexport function CrsScoreBadge({\n  score,\n  band,\n  large = false,\n}: {\n  score: number;\n  band: ScoreBand;\n  large?: boolean;\n}) {\n  const palette = BAND_STYLES[band];\n\n  return (\n    <View\n      accessibilityRole=\"text\"\n      accessibilityLabel={`CRS score ${score} out of 1200. ${BAND_LABELS[band]}.`}\n      className={`flex-row items-center gap-2 rounded-full ${palette.container} ${\n        large ? \"px-4 py-2.5\" : \"px-3 py-1.5\"\n      }`}\n    >\n      <View className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${palette.dot}`} />\n      <Text\n        className={`font-inter-bold ${palette.text} ${\n          large ? \"text-[22px] leading-[26px]\" : \"text-[15px] leading-[20px]\"\n        }`}\n      >\n        {score}\n      </Text>\n      <Text variant=\"label\" className={palette.text}>\n        CRS\n      </Text>\n    </View>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function CrsScoreBar({\n  score,\n  band,\n}: {\n  score: number;\n  band: ScoreBand;\n}) {\n  const percent = Math.min(100, Math.round((score / 1200) * 100));\n\n  return (\n    <View>\n      <View className=\"h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-surface\">\n        <View\n          className={`h-2 rounded-full ${BAND_STYLES[band].bar}`}\n          style={{ width: `${percent}%` }}\n        />\n      </View>\n      <View className=\"mt-2 flex-row justify-between\">\n        <Text variant=\"small\" tone=\"muted\">\n          {score.toLocaleString()} of 1,200 points\n        </Text>\n        <Text variant=\"small\" tone=\"muted\">\n          {percent}% of maximum\n        </Text>\n      </View>\n    </View>\n  );\n}\n"

(\n        <Text variant=\"small\" tone=\"muted\" className=\"mt-1.5\">\n          {description}\n        </Text>\n      ) : null}\n      <View className=\"mt-5 gap-5\">{children}</View>\n    </Card>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function CrsForm({\n  initial,\n  hasExistingScore,\n  branchScore,\n  onSubmit,\n  onCancel,\n}: CrsFormProps) {\n  const [inputs, setInputs] = useState<CrsInputs>(initial);\n  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);\n\n  function update<K extends keyof CrsInputs>(key: K, value: CrsInputs[K]) {\n    setInputs((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));\n  }\n\n  function updateLanguage<B extends ClbBand | SecondLanguageBand>(\n    group: \"firstLanguage\" | \"secondLanguage\",\n    ability: Ability,\n    band: B,\n  ) {\n    setInputs((current) => ({\n      ...current,\n      [group]: { ...current[group], [ability]: band },\n    }));\n  }\n\n  function updateSpouseLanguage(ability: Ability, band: SpouseLanguageBand) {\n    setInputs((current) => ({\n      ...current,\n      spouseFirstLanguage: {\n        ...(current.spouseFirstLanguage ?? {\n          reading: \"below5\",\n          writing: \"below5\",\n          speaking: \"below5\",\n          listening: \"below5\",\n        }),\n        [ability]: band,\n      },\n    }));\n  }\n\n  async function handleCalculate() {\n    const age = Math.min(45, Math.max(17, Math.round(inputs.age) || 30));\n    const normalized: CrsInputs = { ...inputs, age };\n    const result = calculateCrs(normalized);\n    setInputs(normalized);\n    setSubmitting(true);\n    try {\n      await onSubmit(normalized, result);\n    } finally {\n      setSubmitting(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <Screen>\n      <View className=\"flex-row items-center justify-between pt-1\">\n        {branchScore ? (\n          <CrsScoreBadge score={branchScore.score} band={branchScore.band} />\n        ) : (\n          <BrandLockup />\n        )}\n        <View className=\"rounded-full border border-line px-2.5 py-1\">\n          <Text variant=\"label\" tone=\"muted\">\n            CRS check\n          </Text>\n        </View>\n      </View>\n\n      <View className=\"mt-8\">\n        <Text variant=\"label\" tone=\"accent\">\n          {hasExistingScore ? \"Update your answers\" : \"First step\"}\n        </Text>\n        <Text variant=\"title\" className=\"mt-2\">\n          Check your CRS score\n        </Text>\n        <Text variant=\"body\" tone=\"muted\" className=\"mt-2\">\n          Your Comprehensive Ranking System score ranks you in the Express Entry\n          pool. Answer every question using your real profile. We filled in\n          common starting answers — change them all.\n        </Text>\n      </View>\n\n      <Card variant=\"muted\" className=\"mt-5 p-4\">\n        <Text variant=\"small\" tone=\"muted\">\n          This estimate uses IRCC&apos;s CRS rules in force until November 2,\n          2026. Job offer points are not included. IRCC adds high-wage\n          occupation points on November 3, 2026.\n        </Text>\n        <Text\n          variant=\"small\"\n          className=\"mt-2 font-inter-semibold text-ink underline\"\n          onPress={() => void Linking.openURL(CRS_RULES.sourceUrl)}\n        >\n          Read the official criteria\n        </Text>\n      </Card>\n\n      <FormSection\n        label=\"About you\"\n        title=\"Age, education and status\"\n        description=\"These are the largest core factors in your score.\"\n      >\n        <ChoiceGroup\n          label=\"Spouse or common-law partner\"\n          value={inputs.maritalStatus}\n          options={[\n            { value: \"single\", label: \"No accompanying spouse\" },\n            { value: \"withSpouse\", label: \"Spouse is coming with me\" },\n          ]}\n          onChange={(value) => update(\"maritalStatus\", value)}\n          helper=\"Choose the first option if you have no spouse, your spouse is a Canadian citizen or PR, or they are not coming with you.\"\n        />\n        <TextField\n          label=\"Age\"\n          value={inputs.age ? String(inputs.age) : \"\"}\n          onChangeText={(text) =>\n            update(\"age\", Number(text.replace(/[^0-9]/g, \"\")) || 0)\n          }\n          onBlur={() =>\n            update(\"age\", Math.min(45, Math.max(17, inputs.age || 30)))\n          }\n          keyboardType=\"number-pad\"\n          inputMode=\"numeric\"\n          maxLength={2}\n          placeholder=\"30\"\n          helper=\"Points are highest between ages 20 and 29.\"\n        />\n        <SelectField\n          label=\"Highest level of education\"\n          value={inputs.education}\n          options={EDUCATION_OPTIONS}\n          onChange={(value) => update(\"education\", value)}\n          helper=\"Count only education you completed and can prove.\"\n        />\n      </FormSection>\n\n      <FormSection\n        label=\"Language\"\n        title=\"Official language ability\"\n        description=\"Use the lowest result across your four abilities. now()\n);\n\nalter table public.profiles enable row level security;\n\ncreate policy \"profiles_select_own\"\n  on public.profiles for select\n  to authenticated\n  using ((select auth.uid()) = id);\n\ncreate policy \"profiles_update_own\"\n  on public.profiles for update\n  to authenticated\n  using ((select auth.uid()) = id)\n  with check ((select auth.uid()) = id);\n\n-- Create the profile automatically when someone signs up.\ncreate or replace function public.handle_new_user()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\nbegin\n  insert into public.profiles (id, email)\n  values (new.id, new.email)\n  on conflict (id) do nothing;\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ndrop trigger if exists on_auth_user_created on auth.users;\ncreate trigger on_auth_user_created\n  after insert on auth.users\n  for each row execute function public.handle_new_user();\n\n-- Every CRS check is kept so the applicant can see how their score changes.\ncreate table if not exists public.crs_snapshots (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  user_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,\n  score integer not null check (score between 0 and 1200),\n  breakdown jsonb not null,\n  inputs jsonb not null,\n  rules_version text not null,\n  created_at timestamptz not null default now()\n);\n\ncreate index if not exists crs_snapshots_user_created_idx\n  on public.crs_snapshots (user_id, created_at desc);\n\nalter table public.crs_snapshots enable row level security;\n\ncreate policy \"crs_snapshots_select_own\"\n  on public.crs_snapshots for select\n  to authenticated\n  using ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);\n\ncreate policy \"crs_snapshots_insert_own\"\n  on public.crs_snapshots for insert\n  to authenticated\n  with check ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);\n\ncreate policy \"crs_snapshots_delete_own\"\n  on public.crs_snapshots for delete\n  to authenticated\n  using ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);\n"

import fs from "node:fs";

const PORT = process.env.CDP_PORT ?? "9333";
const BASE = "http://localhost:8081";
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

async function getPageTarget() {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 40; attempt += 1) {
    try {
      const targets = await (await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/json/list`)).json();
      const page = targets.find((target) => target.type === "page");
      if (page?.webSocketDebuggerUrl) return page;
    } catch {}
    await sleep(250);
  }
  throw new Error("No debuggable page found");
}

const target = await getPageTarget();
const ws = new WebSocket(target.webSocketDebuggerUrl);
await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  ws.onopen = resolve;
  ws.onerror = reject;
});

let messageId = 0;
const pending = new Map();
const consoleErrors = [];

ws.onmessage = (event) => {
  const message = JSON.parse(event.data);
  if (message.id && pending.has(message.id)) {
    const { resolve, reject } = pending.get(message.id);
    pending.delete(message.id);
    if (message.error) reject(new Error(JSON.stringify(message.error)));
    else resolve(message.result);
    return;
  }
  if (message.method === "Runtime.exceptionThrown") {
    consoleErrors.push(
      message.params.exceptionDetails?.exception?.description ??
        message.params.exceptionDetails?.text ??
        "Unknown exception",
    );
  }
  if (message.method === "Runtime.consoleAPICalled" && message.params.type === "error") {
    consoleErrors.push(
      message.params.args.map((arg) => arg.value ?? arg.description ?? "").join(" "),
    );
  }
};

function send(method, params = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const id = ++messageId;
    pending.set(id, { resolve, reject });
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ id, method, params }));
  });
}

async function evaluate(expression) {
  const result = await send("Runtime.evaluate", {
    expression,
    returnByValue: true,
    awaitPromise: true,
  });
  return result.result?.value;
}

async function setViewport(width, height, mobile) {
  await send("Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride", {
    width,
    height,
    deviceScaleFactor: 2,
    mobile,
    screenWidth: width,
    screenHeight: height,
  });
}

1	# MapleRoute
2	
3	MapleRoute is a step-by-step companion for applying for Canadian Permanent Residence. It is an independent guide — not legal or immigration advice, and not affiliated with IRCC or the Government of Canada.
4	
5	The app is built with Expo (React Native + TypeScript) so one codebase runs on iOS, Android, and the web.
6	
7	**Current status: Phase 0 — foundation.** The app shell, design tokens, brand assets, and a live Supabase connection check are in place. There are no database tables, accounts, or immigration content yet.
8	
9	## What Phase 0 includes
10	
11	- Native tab navigation (Home, Settings) with the MapleRoute design system.
12	- A Home screen that checks the Supabase project from the device and shows one of four states: `Setup needed`, `Connecting…`, `Connected`, or `Not connected`.
13	- A Settings screen with version, Supabase host, the independent-guide notice, and the privacy boundary (MapleRoute never asks for an IRCC password, UCI, or passport number).
14	- App icons, splash image, favicon, EAS build profiles, and `.env.example`.
15	
16	The connection check calls Supabase's public health endpoint (`/auth/v1/health`), so it works before any tables are created.
17	
18	## Prerequisites
19	
20	- Node.js 20 or newer (this project was verified on Node 24).
21	- npm (included with Node).
22	- For a physical phone: the free **Expo Go** app from the App Store or Google Play.
23	- Optional, for native builds: an Expo account and `eas-cli`. Xcode (macOS) or Android Studio is only needed if you want to compile locally.
24	
25	## 1. Install
26	
27	```bash
28	npm install
29	```
30	
31	## 2. Connect Supabase
32	
33	1. Create a project at https://supabase.com (or open the existing one).
34	2. In the Supabase dashboard, open **Project Settings → API**.
35	3. Copy the **Project URL** and the **anon public** key.
36	4. Create your local env file:
37	
38	   macOS / Linux / Git Bash / PowerShell:
39	
40	   ```bash
41	   cp .env.example .env
42	   ```
43	
44	   Windows Command Prompt:
45	
46	   ```bat
47	   copy .env.example .env
48	   ```
49	
50	5. Edit `.env` and fill in both values:
51	
52	   ```
53	   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project-ref.supabase.co
54	   EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your-anon-public-key
55	   ```
56	
57	6. Restart the dev server. Expo inlines `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` values when the bundle starts, so changes do not apply to an already-running server.
58	
59	Use **only** the anon public key in this app. Never put the `service_role` key in `.env` or anywhere in the client — it bypasses Row Level Security. Everything prefixed with `EXPO_PUBLIC_` is visible to anyone who inspects the app.
60	
61	## 3. Run it
62	
63	### Website (local)
64	
65	```bash
66	npm run web
67	```
68	
69	Open http://localhost:8081. The layout is centred at a readable width on desktop and fills the screen on mobile.
70	
71	### Phone with Expo Go
72	
73	1. Put the phone and computer on the same Wi-Fi network.
74	2. Start the dev server:
75	
76	   ```bash
77	   npm run start:go
78	   ```
79	
80	3. Scan the QR code: Camera app on iOS, or the Expo Go app's scanner on Android.
81	
82	If your network blocks device-to-computer connections, use a tunnel:
83	
84	```bash
85	npx expo start --go --tunnel
86	```
87	
88	`npm start` (without `--go`) opens the development build if one is installed. Use `npm run start:go` when you specifically want Expo Go.
89	
90	### Native development build (optional, later)
91	
92	A development build is a real app binary that can use custom native modules. It is not required for Phase 0.
93	
94	```bash
95	npx eas-cli@latest login
96	npx eas-cli@latest init
97	npx eas-cli@latest build --profile development --platform android
98	# or: --platform ios  (iOS device builds require an Apple Developer account)
99	```
100	
101	Install the resulting build on the device, then run:
102	
103	```bash
104	npx expo start --dev-client
105	```
106	
107	The EAS profiles in `eas.json`:
108	
109	| Profile | Use it for | Distribution |
110	| --- | --- | --- |
111	| `development` | Day-to-day development with a dev client | Internal |
112	| `preview` | Test builds for testers | Internal |
113	| `production` | App Store / Play Store releases | Store |
114	
115	```bash
116	npx eas-cli@latest build --profile preview --platform all
117	npx eas-cli@latest build --profile production --platform all
118	```
119	
120	## Scripts
121	
122	| Command | What it does |
123	| --- | --- |
124	| `npm start` | Start the Expo dev server (dev client if installed) |
125	| `npm run start:go` | Start Expo and force Expo Go |
126	| `npm run web` | Start the web version in a browser |
127	| `npm run android` / `npm run ios` | Open on an emulator/simulator |
128	| `npm run typecheck` | TypeScript check with no output files |
129	
130	## Project structure
131	
132	```
133	src/
134	  app/
135	    _layout.tsx          Root layout: fonts, splash, status bar, safe areas
136	    (tabs)/
137	      _layout.tsx        Bottom tab bar
138	      index.tsx          Home: connection check and what's next
139	      settings.tsx       App details, disclaimer, privacy boundary
140	  components/
141	    brand.tsx            Maple leaf mark and brand lockup
142	    connection-card.tsx  Supabase status card and setup steps
143	    disclaimer.tsx       Independent-guide notice
144	    screen.tsx           Shared page frame (safe area, scroll, width)
145	    ui/                  Text, Button, Card, DetailRow, Divider
146	  hooks/
147	    use-supabase-health.ts
148	  lib/
149	    supabase.ts          Client + configuration check
150	    haptics.ts           Native haptics, no-op on web
151	  theme/
152	    tokens.json          Single source of truth for colour, radius, spacing
153	    theme.ts             Typed token exports
154	    shadow.ts            Cross-platform card shadow
155	assets/images/           App icon, Android adaptive icon, splash, favicon
156	```
157	
158	Design tokens live in `src/theme/tokens.json` and are consumed by both `tailwind.config.js` and TypeScript. Change a colour there once and both the styles and native styles pick it up.
159	
160	## Web build and hosting
161	
162	Create a static build:
163	
164	```bash
165	npx expo export --platform web
166	```
167	
168	The output goes to `dist/`. Expo's web output is a single-page app, so a static host must rewrite unknown paths to `index.html`. On Netlify that is a `netlify.toml` at the project root:
169	
170	```toml
171	[[redirects]]
172	  from = "/*"
173	  to = "/index.html"
174	  status = 200
175	```
176	
177	Hosting, the privacy policy, and the support page will be handled in a later phase.
178	
179	## Troubleshooting
180	
181	- **The Home card still says "Setup needed"**: `.env` is missing, both values are not filled in, or the dev server was started before you saved `.env`. Stop the server, confirm the file is at the project root, and start it again.
182	- **"Not connected" with a timeout**: the device cannot reach the Supabase URL. Check the URL, your internet connection, and that the Supabase project is not paused.
183	- **Port 8081 is busy**: another Expo/Metro process is still running. Close it, or start with `npx expo start --web --port 8082`.
184	- **Expo Go shows an incompatible SDK message**: update Expo Go from the app store — this project uses Expo SDK 58.
185	
186	## Data and privacy boundaries
187	
188	Phase 0 stores nothing. Authentication, cloud sync, and account deletion arrive in a later phase and will be built on Supabase Auth, Postgres with Row Level Security, and `expo-secure-store`. MapleRoute will never ask for an IRCC password, UCI, or passport number unless a specific feature is approved and explained first.
189	
190	Immigration requirements, fees, and steps will be stored as data with a `source_url` (canada.ca / IRCC), a `last_verified` date, and a version — not hardcoded in screens.
191

-- MapleRoute Phase 1: accounts and CRS snapshots
-- Run this in Supabase Dashboard > SQL Editor > New query.

-- One profile row per authenticated user.
create table if not exists public.profiles (
  id uuid primary key references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  email text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

alter table public.profiles enable row level security;

drop policy if exists "profiles_select_own" on public.profiles;
drop policy if exists "profiles_update_own" on public.profiles;

create policy "profiles_select_own"
  on public.profiles for select
  to authenticated
  using ((select auth.uid()) = id);

create policy "profiles_update_own"
  on public.profiles for update
  to authenticated
  using ((select auth.uid()) = id)
  with check ((select auth.uid()) = id);

-- Create the profile automatically when someone signs up.
create or replace function public.handle_new_user()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, email)
  values (new.id, new.email)
  on conflict (id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists on_auth_user_created on auth.users;
create trigger on_auth_user_created
  after insert on auth.users
  for each row execute function public.handle_new_user();

-- Every CRS check is kept so the applicant can see how their score changes.
create table if not exists public.crs_snapshots (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  score integer not null check (score between 0 and 1200),
  breakdown jsonb not null,
  inputs jsonb not null,
  rules_version text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists crs_snapshots_user_created_idx
  on public.crs_snapshots (user_id, created_at desc);

alter table public.crs_snapshots enable row level security;

drop policy if exists "crs_snapshots_select_own" on public.crs_snapshots;
drop policy if exists "crs_snapshots_insert_own" on public.crs_snapshots;
drop policy if exists "crs_snapshots_delete_own" on public.crs_snapshots;

create policy "crs_snapshots_select_own"
  on public.crs_snapshots for select
  to authenticated
  using ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);

create policy "crs_snapshots_insert_own"
  on public.crs_snapshots for insert
  to authenticated
  with check ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);

create policy "crs_snapshots_delete_own"
  on public.crs_snapshots for delete
  to authenticated
  using ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);

import Ionicons from "@expo/vector-icons/Ionicons";
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import { hapticLight } from "@/lib/haptics";
import { colors } from "@/theme/theme";

import { Text } from "./text";

export type SelectOption<T extends string> = {
  value: T;
  label: string;
};

type SelectFieldProps<T extends string> = {
  label: string;
  value: T;
  options: SelectOption<T>[];
  onChange: (value: T) => void;
  helper?: string;
};

export function SelectField<T extends string>({
  label,
  value,
  options,
  onChange,
  helper,
}: SelectFieldProps<T>) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const selected = options.find((option) => option.value === value);

  return (
    <View>
      <Text variant="label" tone="muted">
        {label}
      </Text>
      <Pressable
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={`${label}. Selected: ${selected?.label ?? "None"}`}
        onPress={() => {
          hapticLight();
          setOpen(true);
        }}
        className="mt-2 h-[52px] flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-control border border-line bg-canvas px-4 active:bg-surface"
      >
        <Text variant="body" className="flex-1 pr-3" numberOfLines={1}>
          {selected?.label ?? "Select an option"}
        </Text>
        <Ionicons name="chevron-down" size={18} color={colors.muted} />
      </Pressable>
      {helper ? (
        <Text variant="small" tone="muted" className="mt-2">
          {helper}
        </Text>
      ) : null}

      <Modal
        visible={open}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <View className="flex-1 justify-end bg-black/30">
          <Pressable
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="Close options"
            className="absolute inset-0"
            onPress={() => setOpen(false)}
          />
          <View
            className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[680px] rounded-t-panel bg-canvas"
            style={{ paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom, 20) }}
          >
            <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-5 py-4">
              <Text variant="heading">{label}</Text>
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="Close"
                hitSlop={10}
                onPress={() => setOpen(false)}
                className="h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-surface"
              >
                <Ionicons name="close" size={18} color={colors.ink} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>
            <ScrollView className="max-h-[420px]" bounces={false}>
              {options.map((option) => {
                const active = option.value === value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={option.value}
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
                    onPress={() => {
                      hapticLight();
                      onChange(option.value);
                      setOpen(false);
                    }}
                    className={`flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-line px-5 py-4 active:bg-surface ${
                      active ? "bg-surface" : ""
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Text
                      variant="body"
                      className={active ? "flex-1 font-inter-semibold" : "flex-1"}
                    >
                      {option.label}
                    </Text>
                    {active ? (
                      <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={18} color={colors.accent} />
                    ) : null}
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}

import Ionicons from "@expo/vector-icons/Ionicons";
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import { hapticLight } from "@/lib/haptics";
import { colors } from "@/theme/theme";

import { Text } from "./text";

export type SelectOption<T extends string> = {
  value: T;
  label: string;
};

type SelectFieldProps<T extends string> = {
  label: string;
  value: T;
  options: SelectOption<T>[];
  onChange: (value: T) => void;
  helper?: string;
};

export function SelectField<T extends string>({
  label,
  value,
  options,
  onChange,
  helper,
}: SelectFieldProps<T>) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const selected = options.find((option) => option.value === value);

  return (
    <View>
      <Text variant="label" tone="muted">
        {label}
      </Text>
      <Pressable
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={`${label}. Selected: ${selected?.label ?? "None"}`}
        onPress={() => {
          hapticLight();
          setOpen(true);
        }}
        className="mt-2 h-[52px] flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-control border border-line bg-canvas px-4 active:bg-surface"
      >
        <Text variant="body" className="flex-1 pr-3" numberOfLines={1}>
          {selected?.label ?? "Select an option"}
        </Text>
        <Ionicons name="chevron-down" size={18} color={colors.muted} />
      </Pressable>
      {helper ? (
        <Text variant="small" tone="muted" className="mt-2">
          {helper}
        </Text>
      ) : null}

      <Modal
        visible={open}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <View className="flex-1 justify-end bg-black/30">
          <Pressable
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="Close options"
            className="absolute inset-0"
            onPress={() => setOpen(false)}
          />
          <View
            className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[680px] rounded-t-panel bg-canvas"
            style={{ paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom, 20) }}
          >
            <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-5 py-4">
              <Text variant="heading">{label}</Text>
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="Close"
                hitSlop={10}
                onPress={() => setOpen(false)}
                className="h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-surface"
              >
                <Ionicons name="close" size={18} color={colors.ink} />
              </Pressable>
            </View>
            <ScrollView className="max-h-[420px]" bounces={false}>
              {options.map((option) => {
                const active = option.value === value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={option.value}
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
                    onPress={() => {
                      hapticLight();
                      onChange(option.value);
                      setOpen(false);
                    }}
                    className={`flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-line px-5 py-4 active:bg-surface ${
                      active ? "bg-surface" : ""
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Text
                      variant="body"
                      className={active ? "flex-1 font-inter-semibold" : "flex-1"}
                    >
                      {option.label}
                    </Text>
                    {active ? (
                      <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={18} color={colors.accent} />
                    ) : null}
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}
